One blockhash test still expected Kit omission of finalized commitment; its expectation was corrected to the explicit relay contract.
Intermediate test migration failed before the explicit finalized-commitment relay behavior and consumers were fully updated. This is not a final suite result.
Intermediate clearance recovery used the old publicKey.toBase58 API; Kit Address consumers were corrected.
80/81 passed; the remaining test inspected legacy message.recentBlockhash. The assertion was migrated to the native compiled-message lifetimeToken without weakening exact message equality.

Two overlapping npm prepack/build invocations shared packages/sdk/dist and captured pre-rewrite declaration imports. A fresh serial pack passed with the same guarded source inputs; no runtime/build-source fix was needed. The initial e7d5a40bd59873ee9ecbadbd3d55b3fb51952e411a5559c18a89608b327a5d60 artifact was never published.

The pre-existing wallet fixture binary did not accept the pending-escape result name. It was rebuilt from the current locked source before the passing run.

The next invocation used a stale binary with an embedded former CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR and could not find a fixture. Rebuilding from current locked source produced the passing report.
